summary: Fixed the unreleased migrations 0012 (drop and recreate the elevation index, exact integer feet-to-metres rounding) and 0013 (full_name without concat_ws, which needs SQLite 3.44), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (collectors read as cp1252, taxa seed deferred, TS and SD basis codes mapped). A fresh build passes all checks and exports, and an upgraded copy of the 1.6.0 database has the same schema and rows as the fresh build.
